'''Keith Brown''' is listed as '''Communications Advocate''' on public Players Committee organization charts, with forum handle '''darkjediknight11''' and role contact communications@starwarsccg.org. That handle matches the Communications Advocate entry on the ~October 2014 starwarsccg.org About "Current Advocates" block (handle only there).<ref name="swcabout2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141009180158/http://www.starwarsccg.org/about/ About], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 9 October 2014)</ref><ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref> He started the forum thread Region Maps on 3 December 2013 and posted [[Blake Silkwood]]'s 2025 [[SWCCG regions]] maps there on 5 February 2025.<ref name="forum-maps">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=53246 Region Maps], Players Committee forum, t=53246</ref>

== Documented PC roles ==

* '''~October 2014:''' Handle '''darkjediknight11''' listed as Communications Advocate (legal name not printed on that About capture).<ref name="swcabout2014" />
* '''Org chart 2021:''' Communications Advocate; handle '''darkjediknight11'''; legal name Keith Brown.<ref name="orgchart2021" />
* '''Org chart 2024:''' Communications Advocate; handle '''darkjediknight11''' (continuous vs 2021 Advocate row).<ref name="orgchart2024" />

He finished '''#35''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 33).
